findings.claim: Item 5 of the retry prompt (line 60) asks to check the 'camada servida N1'. The real GET /v1/dashboard/alerts response is {items,page,pageSize,total,meta} and has no top-level layer field. servedLayer stays inside the gate (ceiling 'N1'), and each item exposes 'layer' (object_layer, export.service.ts:117). The offline mock in contract.test.mjs:175 returns a top-level 'layer: N1', which differs from the real response. A worker that looks for body.layer would fail live with a false negative.
findings.fix: State that the N1 proof is: the request with ?layer=N1 answers 200 (the gate accepts it with ceiling N1), items[] is non-empty, items[].layer === 'N1', and a concrete alert ID from 81-fixtures-dashboard-state.sql is present. Do not require a top-level layer field.

findings.claim: The offline smokeFixture uses fixture '<name>-fixture-001' while the mock answers items [{id:'fixture-001'}]. Its CH probes have no body, persona or fixture. If the worker derives the concrete-ID check from the existing 'fixture' field, or makes CH persona/body mandatory, pnpm test:stack breaks, and tests cannot be changed in this retry.
findings.fix: Tell the worker to express the new checks (expected IDs, expected layer, persona/policy/precondition per CH probe) as optional target fields, set only in defaultTargets or the CLI. runSmoke stays compatible with the current smokeFixture.

findings.claim: 'verifique fixture concreta e tenant': the real list payloads (for example dashboard items) do not carry tenantId. The current check is conditional (body.tenantId &&). A worker that makes tenantId mandatory would block every GET live.
findings.fix: Clarify that tenant is proven by the x-detran-tenant-id header sent plus a concrete public ID of a fixture seeded under tenant …a001 (RLS scopes it). Check tenantId only when the field exists.

findings.claim: The evidence sensor rejects any 'token|bearer|password|secret'. The contract describes the precondition as '503 sem URL, token' (CTG-0002 §C-02-04). If the worker copies that text into the per-row precondition, or writes an adapterMessage or policy key containing those words, the evidence fails its own sensor.
findings.fix: Tell the worker to write preconditions with neutral codes (for example 'adapter_unconfigured', 'signing_url_absent') and never with the word 'token'.
